title: CV of Mateo Alvarez
summary: Full-Stack Developer - React, Next.js, Node and Postgres; 9 years; employers: Pixelforge Agency, Lumen Health, Independent (freelance)

title: Online booking portal for a clinic network
summary: I built an online appointment system that let patients schedule visits and receive reminder texts, and it drove 40% of bookings to the web while cutting no‑shows by 18%.

title: Shared component library and accessibility pass
summary: I built a shared UI component library that unified buttons, forms and tables for multiple product teams, and we achieved WCAG 2.1 AA compliance across the patient app while cutting UI bugs by a third.

title: Internal CRM replacing spreadsheets for an estate agency
summary: I built a custom CRM that moved Keystone Realty’s 35 agents off spreadsheets, and lead response time dropped by half. The system automated listings pulls, nudged agents on stale leads, and gave role‑based dashboards for staff.

title: Logo refresh for a neighbourhood bakery
summary: I refreshed the bakery’s visual identity with a new logo, and the design now appears on their shop sign and packaging. The updated branding helped the shop look more modern and attracted more foot traffic.

title: Landing page from a Figma design
summary: I built a landing page from a Figma design for a SaaS client, delivering a pixel‑accurate, responsive page in three days. The client got a ready‑to‑launch site that matched their branding perfectly and worked on every device.

title: Performance rescue for a slow online store
summary: I optimized a slow e-commerce storefront by fixing heavy scripts and caching issues. The Lighthouse mobile score improved from 38 to 91.

title: Excel macro for stock counts
summary: I built an Excel macro that automated weekly stock counts, cutting the process from three hours to about twenty minutes. The client now runs a quick, reliable inventory check each week without manual data entry.

title: Subscription billing and plan management for a B2B SaaS
summary: I built a flexible subscription and plan management system that handles upgrades, downgrades and payment events reliably, and the client saw a 22% lift in failed‑payment recovery while eliminating manual finance reconciliation. The solution let their finance team stop reconciling by hand and gave the product team confidence that every charge is processed exactly once.

title: WooCommerce checkout tweaks
summary: I built a custom WooCommerce checkout tweak for a small e‑commerce client, and checkout abandonment dropped by 8%.

title: Habit-tracker mobile app MVP
summary: I built a cross‑platform habit‑tracker MVP for a consumer‑app client and launched it on both the App Store and Google Play in six weeks.

title: Live dispatch board for a freight company
summary: I built a real‑time dispatch dashboard that visualizes trucks and loads instantly as drivers update their status, and it cut driver‑call volume by 60% while doubling the number of loads each dispatcher handles per shift.

title: Browser extension that tracks price drops
summary: I built a lightweight browser extension that monitors product pages for price drops and notifies users. It achieved 3,000 installs in its first month.

title: Fixing split payouts on a two-sided marketplace
summary: I debugged a complex payout logic error in a two-sided marketplace platform. We reduced payout failures from 4% to zero by restructuring the transaction state machine.

title: Product-bundle builder app for a Shopify store
summary: I built a custom bundle configurator that lets shoppers assemble personalized gift boxes directly on the Oak & Ember store. The live‑price updates drove a 14% lift in average order value during the first quarter.

title: Moving a magazine off WordPress to a headless stack
summary: I rebuilt Northbound Magazine’s site on a modern headless architecture, moving content editing to a familiar interface while pre‑generating pages for speed. The launch cut LCP from 4.1 s to 1.6 s and lifted organic traffic by 19 % in three months.

title: GraphQL API for a gym chain's member app
summary: I built a GraphQL API for a gym chain’s member app, consolidating data from 22 locations into a single endpoint. The new API powers both web and mobile experiences, cutting request latency and simplifying development.

title: Multi-tenant authentication and permissions service
summary: I built a multi‑tenant authentication and permission layer for Ledgerly’s fintech platform, isolating each client’s data at the database level and integrating their own identity providers for single sign‑on. The solution cleared the SOC 2 Type I audit with zero auth findings and unlocked several enterprise SSO contracts.

title: Migrating an app from Firebase to Supabase
summary: I migrated the client’s education app from Firebase to Supabase, handling the full data transfer and code updates. The move cut their hosting bill by 45% and kept every piece of data intact.

title: End-to-end test suite for a booking app
summary: I built a full automated test suite for a travel booking app, covering its core booking flow and edge cases. The suite caught regressions before each release, turning rare bugs into routine detections.

title: api-starter
summary: A lightweight TypeScript API starter that wires request validation, error handling, and Prisma‑based database access together. It lets a new backend go from zero to a working endpoint in a day instead of a week.

title: bundle-builder
summary: A TypeScript Remix app that lets shoppers compose product bundles with live price updates, and provides an admin UI for staff to define bundle rules stored in a SQLite database.

title: live-board
summary: A real‑time dispatch board that shows trucks and loads moving on a map, syncing updates across multiple server instances via Redis pub/sub. Dispatchers can see live location changes instantly, improving load handling efficiency.

title: subscription-kit
summary: A TypeScript library that manages subscription plan changes with pro‑rated billing using Stripe and Prisma. It ensures each payment event is processed exactly once, even on webhook retries.

title: tenant-guard
summary: A NestJS service that enforces row‑level security per tenant and handles SSO via OpenID Connect. It validates JWTs, extracts the tenant ID, and applies PostgreSQL policies so each customer only sees their own data.
